name: Vonny Cornellya
bio: Vonny Cornellya Permatasari known as Vonny Cornelia is an Indonesian actress. Vonny once known as a member of the vocal group Bening.

credits.title: People Pleaser: Si Paling Gak Enakan
credits.overview: Karina is a young woman who always puts others first and finds it difficult to say "no." This habit leaves her exhausted and causes her to sacrifice her own dreams.

credits.title: Why Do You Love Me
credits.overview: Baskara, a paraplegic with paralyzed nerves, Danton with a brain tumor that paralyzes his lower body, and Miko with retinitis pigmentosa, which has made him completely blind. But they are not going to let anything stand in their way, hellbent to finally losing their virginity.

credits.title: My Sassy Girl
credits.overview: Gian, a young man saves Sisy, a woman who makes drunk, depressed and wants to kill herself at a train station at night. Their love story started from this.

credits.title: #FriendButMarried 2
credits.overview: As Ayu and Ditto finally transition from best friends to newlyweds, a quick pregnancy creates uncertainty for the future of their young marriage.

credits.title: Hunter in The Blue Side of Manchester
credits.overview: To honor his father, a diligent college graduate takes on the daunting goal of becoming a reporter for an English Premier League soccer club.

credits.title: Asal Kau Bahagia
credits.overview: Ali had a severe accident that had to lie down in a coma. Although his body lays helpless and has to race between life and death, Ali's soul remained alive like a human being.

credits.title: Lost
credits.overview: After moving to a village in the forest, a young woman seeks to connect with her late father through a sacred well — but it houses a pernicious spirit.

credits.title: The Self-Claimed Prophet
credits.overview: Rianti and Ajie are two young lovers, whose parents disapprove of their relationship. Rianti finds solace with a preacher, Guru Samir. In the process of trying to reconcile with Rianti, Ajie begins to suspect that Guru Samir is a false prophet.
